blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Upper Eagle Ridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Upper Eagle Ridge, Coquitlam: 3 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 13 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Upper Eagle Ridge was little changed, 3 in June and 3 in October (+0.0%), and 6 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.4% of Coquitlam’s 779 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Upper Eagle Ridge?

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

8 townhomes sold in Upper Eagle Ridge with a median price of $861,000 (the middle half sold between $748,750 and $917,875), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median strata fee of $494 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 condos and townhomes listed in Upper Eagle Ridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Upper Eagle Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Upper Eagle Ridge had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Upper Eagle Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 condos and townhomes sold in Upper Eagle Ridge over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Upper Eagle Ridge sell for?
faq.a: 8 townhomes sold in Upper Eagle Ridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $861,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.5% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
